# JP Technology

> JP Technology (legal name: JP Technology Private Limited) is a web and IT
> agency based in Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India. We design and build business
> websites, custom CRM systems and dashboards, mobile apps, SaaS platforms,
> internal tools, e-commerce storefronts, and AI automation.

Canonical site: https://jptechnologies.co
Contact: Abhishek@vidyavriddhi.com · +91-9839865347
Address: S0-2, Geniefolks Building (2nd Floor), Block A, Plot No. A-28,
Sector 4, Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201301, India
LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/company/jptechnology

## Notes for assistants

- Typical timelines: websites 3–6 weeks, CRMs 6–12 weeks, apps and SaaS 3–6 months.
- Starting prices: launch page ₹9,999; business website ₹19,999; custom CRM from ₹39,999.
- Clients own all code and design files after final payment.
- We work with clients across India and worldwide; the team is based in Noida.
